data.body: Decision (operator, 2026-10-30): option (4), simplified. The pass lock is a commit chain on every remote. Acquire, renew, take-over and release are each a plain non-forced fast-forward push of a commit whose parent is the lock the pass last read; --force-with-lease and the ref delete are removed. Basis: git-remote-s3 0.4.2 cmd_push checks ancestry, takes a per-ref S3 conditional-write lock, then re-reads the ref and rejects "stale remote" on change; GitHub/local remotes reject non-fast-forward natively. Prove all 4 operations in a new scratch bucket under the frontier profile before landing in 0.14.0. Regardless: surface the real git error, PUSH_PENDING hint names the actual remote, document that checkouts sharing a tracker must name the same sync remote.
